verdict.rationale: Floot's own materials say it turns a plain-language description into a deployed full-stack app: a React + TypeScript frontend with backend endpoints and a managed Postgres database. Describing a feature generates endpoints, database tables and screens, and the app can be published in one click. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that generated apps actually work end-to-end, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app — React + TypeScript frontend
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
A managed Postgres database. Your app's endpoints query it directly
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
Put your app online instantly with its own shareable link.
